headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and major numbers. Tracking tight for larger sizes.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, input fields, and standard text.

mono.usage: Use for SKUs, Barcodes, Receipt/Struk details, and transaction IDs.

borders.note: Use subtle 1px borders everywhere. The UI should rely on borders for structure, not heavy shadows.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use standard Tailwind, but amplified: p-6 to p-8 for cards, gap-6 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.pos_terminal_layout: Split layout: 70% left (Products Grid/Search), 30% right (Persistent Cart & Actions). Sticky cart on right.
grids_and_layouts.app_shell: Left sidebar (w-64) containing 9 menus, user identity at bottom. Topbar with quick actions, breadcrumbs, search, and dark mode toggle.

component_specifications.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg, crisp padding (px-6 py-3 for POS actions). Huge buttons (h-16) for Pay/Checkout in POS.
component_specifications.inputs: Shadcn standard but 44px height for touch-friendliness. Focus ring must be highly visible (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).
component_specifications.tables: Shadcn Table. MUST have dense padding (py-2) for dense data, sticky headers, pagination at bottom. Use IBM Plex Sans.
component_specifications.stat_cards: Use MagicUI MagicCard or basic flat card with a subtle top border indicating category. Value text uses Manrope text-4xl font-extrabold.
component_specifications.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40). No native browser confirm().
component_specifications.toast: Use Sonner. Position: top-right. Success/Error themes must be distinct.
component_specifications.skeletons: Replace all spinners with Shadcn Skeleton or MagicUI Shimmer for loading states.

magicui_and_shadcn_usage.NumberTicker: Use for Dashboard revenue (Omzet) and POS Cart Total.
magicui_and_shadcn_usage.AnimatedList: Use for 'Recent Transactions' or 'Stok Menipis' list in Dashboard to make it feel alive.
magicui_and_shadcn_usage.ShimmerButton: Use for the primary 'BAYAR' (Pay) button in the POS terminal.
magicui_and_shadcn_usage.MagicCard: Use for the 4 Stat Cards on the Dashboard.
magicui_and_shadcn_usage.Shadcn_Charts: Use AreaChart for Omzet Trend, PieChart for Payment Methods, BarChart for Top Products.

motion_and_microinteractions.hover: Hovering interactive elements slightly darkens background and lifts up (-translate-y-0.5) with transition-transform.
motion_and_microinteractions.pos_cart_add: Flash green background momentarily or a subtle shake animation on the cart item when quantity increases.

1_Kasir_Terminal.layout: Grid split (L 70% / R 30%). L: Search bar, category pills, product grid (large touch targets). R: Cart items list, discounts, tax, massive total, and big 'Bayar (F12)' ShimmerButton.
1_Kasir_Terminal.features: Keyboard-first (e.g., F2 search, F12 pay). Numeric keypad fallback on screen for touch.

2_Dashboard.layout: Bento Grid. Top row: 4 MagicCard stat cards. Middle row: Area chart (col-span-8), Pie chart (col-span-4). Bottom row: Top products (col-span-6), Stok menipis AnimatedList (col-span-6).

3_Transaksi.layout: Filter bar at top (Date picker, status). Data table below with row-click opening a Shadcn Sheet (right drawer) showing Receipt details (IBM Plex Sans, monospaced).

4_Produk_Supplier_Stok.layout: Standard CRUD layout. Page header with 'Tambah' button. Data table with Sortable columns. Shadcn Dialog for Create/Edit forms.

5_Kas_Shift.layout: Centered constrained layout (max-w-3xl). Two prominent cards: 'Buka Shift' and 'Tutup Shift'. Input for physical cash count comparing with expected cash.

6_Auth.layout: Split screen. Left: Branding/Illustration with MagicUI AnimatedGridPattern background. Right: Login form in a clean white card.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Dark mode uses #FAFAFA on #121214.
accessibility.keyboard: POS must be 100% keyboard navigable. Visual focus rings are mandatory.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-pay-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete UI with standard Shadcn UI components first, then enhance with MagicUI where specified.
The POS terminal page must prioritize speed: do not add heavy 3D or blocking animations.
DO NOT use Inter font for headings. Use Manrope for Headings, IBM Plex Sans for body, and JetBrains Mono for receipts.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The POS terminal should be usable on tablets.
Use Sonner for all notifications, avoid native browser alerts.
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, select menus, or dialogs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers or command palettes.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-lg) with clear interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
